# Before Manderley: Rebecca's Monte Carlo and the Romance of the Riviera

It's one of the most famous novels of the twentieth century. An unnamed young woman. A wealthy, mysterious widower. A magnificent country house. And the enduring influence of a woman who is no longer alive. Most readers associate Daphne du Maurier's Rebecca with Manderley, the imposing English estate that dominates the novel. But before the heroine enters that world, another place shapes her future. Monte Carlo.

Here, in an expensive Riviera hotel, the young narrator works as a paid companion to a wealthy American woman, Mrs Van Hopper. She spends her days following instructions, enduring awkward social situations and feeling painfully conscious of her own lack of money and status. Then she encounters Maxim de Winter. He's rich, reserved and recently widowed. Their acquaintance begins amid the hotels, gardens and fashionable society of the Mediterranean coast.

And what initially looks like the beginning of a romantic escape eventually leads the narrator towards a very different life. This guide explores the real Monte Carlo behind the opening of Rebecca. It isn't an attempt to present the whole book as a Monaco novel. Most of the story takes place in England, and Manderley is its emotional and architectural centre.

Instead, we'll focus on the Riviera chapters, the social world they represent and a short literary walk through Monte Carlo that you can enjoy from Menton. You don't need to have read the book. And if you have, the route offers a new perspective on why du Maurier began this unsettling story in such a beautiful place.

# Avant Manderley : Rebecca à Monte-Carlo et le romanesque de la Riviera

Une jeune femme sans prénom, un veuf riche et mystérieux, une demeure anglaise et l'influence persistante d'une absente : Rebecca figure parmi les grands romans du XXe siècle. On l'associe surtout à Manderley, mais avant cette maison, une autre ville transforme l'avenir de la narratrice : Monte-Carlo.

Dans un hôtel coûteux, elle travaille comme dame de compagnie de Mrs Van Hopper, une Américaine fortunée. Elle suit ses instructions, supporte des situations gênantes et mesure constamment son manque d'argent et de statut. Elle rencontre alors Maxim de Winter, réservé et récemment veuf. Entre hôtels, jardins et société élégante, une promesse d'évasion romantique commence, avant de conduire vers une vie bien différente.

Ce guide explore le Monte-Carlo des premiers chapitres, pas l'ensemble du roman : l'essentiel se déroule ensuite en Angleterre, autour de Manderley. La promenade propose de comprendre un milieu social et une atmosphère, sans inventer d'adresse littéraire ni révéler les grands secrets du livre. On peut la suivre avant ou après la lecture, depuis Menton.

# Prima di Manderley: la Monte Carlo di Rebecca e il fascino della Riviera

Una giovane donna senza nome, un vedovo ricco e misterioso, una grande dimora inglese e l'influenza di una donna assente: Rebecca è fra i romanzi più celebri del Novecento. Lo associamo soprattutto a Manderley, ma prima della casa un altro luogo cambia il futuro della protagonista: Monte Carlo.

In un albergo costoso lavora come dama di compagnia di Mrs Van Hopper, americana benestante. Segue istruzioni, sopporta situazioni imbarazzanti e avverte continuamente la propria mancanza di denaro e prestigio. Poi incontra Maxim de Winter, riservato e da poco vedovo. Fra alberghi, giardini e società elegante nasce una promessa di evasione romantica, destinata a condurla verso una vita diversa.

Questa guida esplora i capitoli iniziali, non presenta l'intero romanzo come una storia monegasca. La parte principale si svolge in Inghilterra e Manderley ne è il centro emotivo. La passeggiata da Mentone serve a capire un ambiente sociale senza inventare indirizzi o rivelare i grandi segreti del libro. Si può seguirla prima o dopo la lettura.

# До Мандерлі: Монте-Карло «Ребекки» й романтика Рив'єри

Молода жінка без імені, заможний таємничий вдівець, великий англійський маєток і тривалий вплив відсутньої жінки: «Ребекка» належить до найвідоміших романів XX століття. Ми пов'язуємо її насамперед із Мандерлі, але до цього будинку майбутнє героїні змінює інше місце — Монте-Карло.

У дорогому готелі вона працює компаньйонкою багатої американки місіс Ван Гоппер. Виконує доручення, терпить незручні ситуації й постійно відчуває брак грошей та статусу. Потім зустрічає Максима де Вінтера, стриманого й нещодавно овдовілого. Серед готелів, садів та світського товариства починається обіцянка романтичної втечі, що веде до зовсім іншого життя.

Цей гід досліджує початкові розділи, не видаючи весь роман за історію про Монако. Основна дія відбувається в Англії, а Мандерлі лишається її емоційним центром. Прогулянка з Ментона допомагає зрозуміти соціальне середовище, не вигадуючи адрес і не розкриваючи головних таємниць. Її можна пройти до або після читання.

## 1. Discover Rebecca by Daphne du Maurier

Rebecca Author: Daphne du Maurier (1907–1989) First published: 1938, Victor Gollancz Genre: Gothic fiction, psychological suspense, literary romance Principal fictional settings: Monte Carlo and Manderley, an English country estate associated with Cornwall Rebecca is narrated by a young woman whose first name is never revealed. At the beginning of the remembered story, she's employed as a companion to Mrs Van Hopper, an affluent American visitor staying at a luxury hotel in Monte Carlo.

The narrator is inexperienced, shy and acutely aware of the differences between herself and the people around her. When she meets Maxim de Winter, the owner of Manderley, their acquaintance offers the possibility of a completely different future. That's enough of the story for this guide. The relationship becomes the doorway to the novel's central mystery, but the most important discoveries belong to readers, not a travel article.

### Why read it?

Rebecca combines the emotional appeal of romantic fiction with the atmosphere of a Gothic psychological thriller. Du Maurier is particularly interested in memory, power, jealousy and the ways people compare themselves with others. The novel's first-person narration makes the reader unusually close to the heroine's insecurities and misunderstandings. And the contrast between Monte Carlo and Manderley is essential. The sunny Mediterranean beginning feels almost like a different literary genre from the darker story that follows.

### Where to find it

- [Discover Daphne du Maurier and Rebecca through the Daphne du Maurier website](https://www.dumaurier.org/)

- [Rebecca: Penguin Books](https://www.penguin.co.uk/search?query=Rebecca%20Daphne%20du%20Maurier)

The novel is available in numerous editions, translations and audiobook formats. For this literary walk, any complete edition of the original novel will work.

## 1. Découvrir Rebecca de Daphne du Maurier

Rebecca, de Daphne du Maurier (1907–1989), paraît en 1938 chez Victor Gollancz. Roman gothique, suspense psychologique et récit amoureux s'y rencontrent. Monte-Carlo et Manderley, domaine anglais associé à la Cornouailles, constituent ses principaux cadres fictionnels.

La narratrice, dont le prénom n'est jamais révélé, se souvient de son emploi auprès de Mrs Van Hopper dans un hôtel de luxe. Timide et inexpérimentée, elle ressent chaque différence avec les personnes qui l'entourent. La rencontre avec le propriétaire de Manderley ouvre la possibilité d'une autre existence. Pour ce guide, cela suffit : les découvertes essentielles appartiennent au lecteur.

### Pourquoi le lire ?

Du Maurier combine l'attrait d'une histoire d'amour avec une atmosphère inquiétante. Mémoire, pouvoir, jalousie et comparaison aux autres traversent le récit. La première personne rapproche le lecteur des incertitudes de l'héroïne, sans lui donner une vision complète. Le soleil méditerranéen semble appartenir à un autre genre que les ombres qui suivent : le contraste compte autant que l'intrigue.

### Trouver le livre

[Site littéraire Daphne du Maurier](https://www.dumaurier.org/)

[Éditions de Rebecca chez Penguin](https://www.penguin.co.uk/search?query=Rebecca%20Daphne%20du%20Maurier)

De nombreuses éditions, traductions et versions audio existent. Une édition intégrale convient pour préparer cette promenade ; nul besoin de rechercher un volume de collection.

## 1. Scoprire Rebecca di Daphne du Maurier

Rebecca, di Daphne du Maurier (1907–1989), viene pubblicato nel 1938 da Victor Gollancz. Unisce narrativa gotica, suspense psicologica e relazione sentimentale. Monte Carlo e Manderley, tenuta inglese associata alla Cornovaglia, sono i principali ambienti immaginari.

La narratrice, il cui nome non viene rivelato, ricorda il lavoro per Mrs Van Hopper in un hotel di lusso. È timida, inesperta e consapevole delle differenze con gli altri ospiti. Incontrare il proprietario di Manderley sembra aprire un'altra possibilità di vita. Per questa guida basta così: le scoperte decisive spettano al lettore.

### Perché leggerlo?

Du Maurier combina l'attrazione di una storia d'amore con un'atmosfera inquietante. Memoria, potere, gelosia e confronto con gli altri attraversano il racconto. La prima persona ci avvicina alle insicurezze della protagonista senza offrirci tutte le informazioni. Il Mediterraneo luminoso sembra quasi un genere diverso dal mondo più oscuro che segue: il contrasto è essenziale.

### Dove trovare il libro

[Sito letterario Daphne du Maurier](https://www.dumaurier.org/)

[Edizioni di Rebecca presso Penguin](https://www.penguin.co.uk/search?query=Rebecca%20Daphne%20du%20Maurier)

Esistono molte edizioni, traduzioni e versioni audio. Qualsiasi edizione integrale va bene per preparare la passeggiata; non occorre un volume da collezione.

## 1. Відкрити «Ребекку» Дафни дю Мор'є

Роман Дафни дю Мор'є (1907–1989) вийшов 1938 року у Victor Gollancz. У ньому поєднано готичну прозу, психологічну напругу й любовну історію. Монте-Карло та Мандерлі, вигаданий англійський маєток, пов'язаний із Корнуоллом, — головні простори оповіді.

Оповідачка, чиє ім'я не названо, згадує роботу при місіс Ван Гоппер у розкішному готелі. Сором'язлива й недосвідчена, вона гостро відчуває відмінності між собою та гостями. Знайомство з власником Мандерлі наче відкриває інше майбутнє. Для цього гіда достатньо: ключові відкриття належать читачеві.

### Чому варто читати?

Дю Мор'є поєднує привабливість роману про кохання з тривожною атмосферою. Пам'ять, влада, ревнощі та порівняння себе з іншими визначають історію. Перша особа наближає нас до невпевненості героїні, не даючи повної картини. Сонячне Середземномор'я здається майже іншим жанром порівняно з наступними тінями: контраст принциповий.

### Де знайти книжку

[Літературний сайт Daphne du Maurier](https://www.dumaurier.org/)

[Видання Rebecca у Penguin](https://www.penguin.co.uk/search?query=Rebecca%20Daphne%20du%20Maurier)

Є багато видань, перекладів та аудіоверсій. Для підготовки підійде будь-який повний текст; колекційне видання не потрібне.

## 2. What actually happens in Monte Carlo?

The novel doesn't begin with the heroine arriving at the casino. Its famous opening is a memory of Manderley. The narrative then returns to the earlier period when the young woman was staying in Monte Carlo with Mrs Van Hopper. This creates a deliberate contrast between the remembered Riviera and the narrator's later experiences.

### The hotel

Mrs Van Hopper is staying at the fictional Hôtel Côte d'Azur. The hotel is grand, expensive and socially intimidating. Its public rooms are places where wealthy guests observe one another, exchange gossip and make introductions. The narrator occupies an awkward position. She's a guest in the hotel, but only because she's employed by someone who can afford to stay there. She belongs to the setting physically without belonging to its social world.

### The meeting

Maxim de Winter is another hotel guest. Mrs Van Hopper takes an immediate interest in him because of his wealth, position and reputation. The young narrator becomes involved almost accidentally in their acquaintance. As the story develops, Monte Carlo provides the setting for a series of encounters, conversations and outings. Du Maurier uses the apparent leisure of Riviera life to reveal very different experiences of wealth, independence and dependence.

### Why Monte Carlo matters

The contrast between the narrator's social position and Maxim's status is essential to the relationship. Monte Carlo makes that contrast particularly visible. It's a place designed around privilege, luxury and being seen. For Mrs Van Hopper, this is an enjoyable environment. For her companion, it can be humiliating. For Maxim, it offers temporary distance from his life in England. The same hotel means something different to each person.

## 2. Que se passe-t-il réellement à Monte-Carlo ?

Le roman ne commence pas par une arrivée au casino. Son ouverture célèbre évoque le souvenir de Manderley, puis le récit revient au séjour antérieur avec Mrs Van Hopper. Le lecteur regarde donc la Riviera à travers une mémoire déjà transformée par la suite des événements.

### L'hôtel

Mrs Van Hopper séjourne au fictif Hôtel Côte d'Azur : grand, cher et intimidant. Salons et salle à manger permettent aux visiteurs riches de s'observer, de commenter les autres et de se faire présenter. La narratrice est physiquement une cliente, mais seulement parce qu'elle travaille pour quelqu'un qui peut payer. Elle appartient au décor sans appartenir pleinement à son monde social.

### La rencontre

Maxim de Winter est lui aussi client. Sa fortune, sa position et sa réputation attirent immédiatement Mrs Van Hopper. Sa jeune employée se trouve presque malgré elle entraînée dans cette connaissance. Rencontres, conversations et excursions montrent que les loisirs de la Riviera n'ont pas le même sens pour tous.

### Pourquoi cette ville ?

Monte-Carlo rend visible l'écart entre dépendance et indépendance. Pour Mrs Van Hopper, l'hôtel est un terrain de relations sociales ; pour sa compagne, il peut être humiliant ; pour Maxim, il offre une distance temporaire avec l'Angleterre. Une même architecture peut ainsi abriter trois expériences opposées du privilège.

## 2. Che cosa succede davvero a Monte Carlo?

Il romanzo non comincia con l'arrivo dell'eroina al casinò. La celebre apertura ricorda Manderley; poi la narrazione torna al precedente soggiorno con Mrs Van Hopper. La Riviera viene quindi osservata attraverso una memoria già segnata dagli eventi successivi.

### L'albergo

Mrs Van Hopper soggiorna nel fittizio Hôtel Côte d'Azur: grande, costoso e socialmente intimidatorio. Saloni e sala da pranzo permettono ai ricchi di osservarsi, commentarsi e farsi presentare. La narratrice è ospite fisicamente, ma solo grazie al lavoro per chi può pagare. Appartiene allo scenario senza appartenere al suo mondo.

### L'incontro

Anche Maxim è ospite. Ricchezza, posizione e reputazione attirano Mrs Van Hopper, coinvolgendo quasi per caso la giovane dipendente. Incontri, conversazioni e uscite mostrano che il tempo libero in Riviera non ha lo stesso significato per tutti.

### Perché questa città conta

Monte Carlo rende evidente la distanza fra dipendenza e autonomia. Per Mrs Van Hopper l'hotel offre contatti; per la sua accompagnatrice può essere umiliante; per Maxim è una distanza temporanea dall'Inghilterra. Lo stesso edificio contiene esperienze molto diverse del privilegio.

## 2. Що насправді відбувається в Монте-Карло?

Роман не починається прибуттям героїні до казино. Знаменитий вступ згадує Мандерлі, потім оповідь повертається до попереднього перебування з місіс Ван Гоппер. Тому Рив'єру ми бачимо крізь пам'ять, уже змінену наступним досвідом.

### Готель

Місіс Ван Гоппер живе у вигаданому Hôtel Côte d'Azur — великому, дорогому й соціально приголомшливому. Вітальні та їдальня дозволяють багатим спостерігати одне за одним, пліткувати й знайомитися. Оповідачка фізично теж гостя, але лише тому, що працює на людину, здатну платити. Вона належить декораціям, але не світові привілеїв.

### Зустріч

Максим також мешкає в готелі. Його статки, становище й репутація відразу цікавлять місіс Ван Гоппер, майже випадково втягуючи молоду працівницю у знайомство. Зустрічі, розмови й виїзди показують, що курортне дозвілля має для людей різний зміст.

### Чому місто важливе

Монте-Карло робить видимою відстань між залежністю й самостійністю. Для місіс Ван Гоппер готель дає контакти; для компаньйонки може бути принизливим; для Максима — тимчасовою відстанню від Англії. Одна будівля вміщує різні досвіди привілею.

## 3. Was the Hôtel Côte d'Azur a real hotel?

This is the most important practical distinction for anyone trying to follow the novel. The Hôtel Côte d'Azur is a fictional literary hotel, not a reliably identified historic establishment that visitors can book or tour today. Du Maurier doesn't provide enough verifiable information to establish one precise real-world counterpart. Monte Carlo had several prestigious hotels capable of providing the atmosphere described in the novel. But architectural resemblance isn't evidence of direct inspiration.

### What can you visit instead?

The historic hotel district around Place du Casino provides an excellent introduction to the world du Maurier evokes. You can see the exterior of Hôtel de Paris Monte-Carlo, the Casino de Monte-Carlo and the surrounding Belle Époque architecture. These are real buildings connected with the history of elite tourism in Monaco. They are contextual stops, not confirmed equivalents of the fictional Côte d'Azur hotel. That distinction allows the walk to remain interesting without inventing a literary address.
fr:
## 3. L'Hôtel Côte d'Azur existait-il ?

Le point essentiel : l'hôtel du roman est fictif. Cette recherche n'a pas identifié de contrepartie réelle précise que l'on pourrait réserver ou visiter aujourd'hui. La ressemblance d'une façade ou d'un salon ne prouve pas une inspiration directe.

Monte-Carlo possédait plusieurs grands hôtels capables d'évoquer ce milieu. Cela ne permet pas d'en choisir un arbitrairement comme « le véritable hôtel de Rebecca ».

### Que voir à la place ?

Le quartier de la place du Casino donne un aperçu concret du tourisme d'élite : façades de l'Hôtel de Paris, Casino de Monte-Carlo et architecture Belle Époque. Ce sont des étapes de contexte historique, pas des équivalents confirmés du Côte d'Azur. Cette distinction permet d'apprécier les lieux sans fabriquer une adresse littéraire.
it:
## 3. L'Hôtel Côte d'Azur era un albergo reale?

È la distinzione pratica fondamentale: l'albergo letterario è immaginario. Le fonti usate qui non identificano una precisa controparte reale che oggi si possa prenotare o visitare. La somiglianza architettonica non dimostra un'ispirazione diretta.

Monte Carlo aveva diversi alberghi prestigiosi capaci di evocare quel mondo. Non è corretto sceglierne uno arbitrariamente come «il vero hotel di Rebecca».

### Che cosa visitare invece?

Il quartiere di Place du Casino rende concreto il turismo d'élite: esterni dell'Hôtel de Paris, Casino de Monte-Carlo e architettura Belle Époque. Sono tappe di contesto storico, non equivalenti confermati del Côte d'Azur. Così la passeggiata resta interessante senza fabbricare un indirizzo letterario.

## 3. Чи був Hôtel Côte d'Azur справжнім готелем?

Це головне практичне розрізнення: літературний готель вигаданий. Використані тут джерела не встановлюють конкретного реального відповідника, який сьогодні можна забронювати чи відвідати. Архітектурна подібність не доводить прямого натхнення.

У Монте-Карло було кілька престижних готелів, здатних викликати потрібну атмосферу. Це не дозволяє довільно оголосити один із них «справжнім готелем Ребекки».

### Що подивитися натомість?

Район Place du Casino показує реальне середовище елітного туризму: фасади Hôtel de Paris, Casino de Monte-Carlo й архітектуру Belle Époque. Це історичні контекстні зупинки, не підтверджені відповідники Côte d'Azur. Так можна насолодитися місцями без вигаданої літературної адреси.

## 4. Monte Carlo in the 1930s: wealth, travel and social hierarchy

By the time Rebecca was published in 1938, Monte Carlo had been an international luxury destination for decades. Its development was closely connected with the casino, grand hotels, railway access and the growth of European leisure travel. Wealthy visitors arrived from Britain and elsewhere in Europe. Some came for gambling and entertainment. Others came to escape colder weather, spend the winter or participate in fashionable social life. Hotels were more than places to sleep. Their lounges, dining rooms and terraces were important social environments.

They provided opportunities to observe others, form acquaintances and display status.

### The social world of Mrs Van Hopper

Mrs Van Hopper's behaviour is particularly revealing. She is determined to meet people she considers important. The hotel gives her an opportunity to pursue social connections in a setting where wealth and reputation are constantly visible. The narrator, meanwhile, occupies an insecure position within that same environment. She is neither an independent tourist nor a conventional servant. Her employment requires her to participate in a world whose rules she doesn't fully control.

### Why this matters today

Modern Monte Carlo remains associated with luxury. But the social world of the novel belongs to a particular historical period. The buildings have changed. Hotels have been renovated. The public square has been redesigned. And the customs governing paid companions, hotel guests and social introductions are no longer identical. A literary visit should explore that history rather than pretend the contemporary casino district is an unchanged 1930s film set.
fr:
## 4. Monte-Carlo dans les années 1930 : richesse et hiérarchie

À la publication de Rebecca en 1938, Monte-Carlo accueille depuis longtemps une clientèle internationale fortunée. Casino, grands hôtels, chemins de fer et voyages de loisirs ont construit cet environnement. Les visiteurs britanniques et européens viennent jouer, se divertir, passer l'hiver ou participer à la vie mondaine.

Les hôtels ne servent pas seulement à dormir. Leurs salons, restaurants et terrasses permettent de rencontrer, d'observer et de montrer sa position. L'architecture organise aussi les rapports sociaux.

### Le monde de Mrs Van Hopper

Elle cherche les personnes qu'elle juge importantes. L'hôtel lui offre un cadre où fortune et réputation sont constamment exposées. Sa compagne occupe une place moins sûre : ni voyageuse indépendante ni domestique conventionnelle, elle doit participer à un milieu dont elle ne maîtrise pas les règles.

### Et aujourd'hui ?

Le luxe demeure, mais les usages et les bâtiments ont changé. Hôtels rénovés, place remaniée, conventions sociales différentes : le quartier actuel n'est pas un décor intact des années 1930. La promenade invite à explorer une histoire, pas à prétendre la retrouver sans transformation.
it:
## 4. Monte Carlo negli anni Trenta: ricchezza e gerarchia

Quando Rebecca esce nel 1938, Monte Carlo è da decenni una destinazione internazionale di lusso. Casinò, grandi alberghi, ferrovia e viaggi di piacere hanno costruito questo ambiente. Visitatori britannici ed europei vengono per gioco, spettacoli, inverno mite e vita mondana.

Gli hotel non sono solo camere: salotti, ristoranti e terrazze servono per incontrare persone, osservare e mostrare il proprio rango. Anche l'architettura organizza i rapporti sociali.

### Il mondo di Mrs Van Hopper

La signora cerca persone che considera importanti. L'albergo offre un luogo in cui reputazione e denaro sono visibili. La sua accompagnatrice ha una posizione incerta: né turista indipendente né domestica convenzionale, deve partecipare a un ambiente di cui non controlla le regole.

### Perché ricordarlo oggi

Il lusso rimane, ma edifici e usanze sono cambiati. Hotel rinnovati, piazza riprogettata e convenzioni diverse: il quartiere contemporaneo non è un set intatto degli anni Trenta. Esploriamo la storia, senza fingere che non ci siano state trasformazioni.

## 4. Монте-Карло 1930-х: гроші й ієрархія

Коли «Ребекка» виходить 1938 року, Монте-Карло вже десятиліттями приймає міжнародну заможну публіку. Казино, великі готелі, залізниця й дозвільні подорожі створили це середовище. Британські та європейські гості приїздять грати, розважатися, зимувати й брати участь у світському житті.

Готелі — не лише кімнати для ночівлі. Салони, ресторани й тераси дають можливість знайомитися, спостерігати й демонструвати становище. Архітектура теж організує соціальні стосунки.

### Світ місіс Ван Гоппер

Вона шукає людей, яких вважає важливими. Готель надає простір, де статки й репутація завжди помітні. Компаньйонка займає непевну позицію: не незалежна туристка й не звичайна служниця, вона мусить брати участь у світі, правила якого не контролює.

### Навіщо пам'ятати це сьогодні

Розкіш лишається, але будівлі й звичаї змінилися. Оновлені готелі, перебудована площа та інші суспільні норми: сучасний квартал не є недоторканою декорацією 1930-х. Прогулянка досліджує історію, а не вдає відсутність змін.

## 5. Place du Casino: the stage of Riviera society

Location: Place du Casino, Monte Carlo. Begin your literary walk at the famous casino square. This is the centre of the historic resort district and the best place to understand the world of luxury travel that forms the background to Rebecca. The square is dominated by the Casino de Monte-Carlo, with its ornate nineteenth-century architecture and impressive entrance. Nearby stand some of the Principality's most prestigious hospitality buildings.

### Why start here?

The novel's Monte Carlo chapters depend on the existence of a recognisable world of elegant hotels and wealthy international visitors. Casino Square embodies that world. You don't have to gamble or enter a luxury hotel to appreciate it. Simply stand in the square and look at how the buildings face the central public space. The architectural arrangement communicates prestige. The casino provides the focal point. The hotels and surrounding establishments complete the social environment.

### What to notice

Look at the monumental scale of the casino façade. Observe the relationship between the historic buildings, gardens and open space. Consider how a hotel lobby or public terrace could function as a place where strangers become aware of one another. That is the kind of social setting du Maurier uses so effectively.

### A historical caution

Today's Casino Square doesn't look exactly as it did in the 1930s. Its most recent major redevelopment was completed in 2020, introducing a substantially redesigned public space. Enjoy the architecture, but don't mistake every modern feature for a detail that the narrator could have seen.

It opened in 1864 and became closely associated with the development of Monte Carlo as an international luxury resort. Its architecture and reputation make it useful for understanding the kind of hotel society described in Rebecca.

### Is this the novel's hotel?

No confirmed evidence identifies Hôtel de Paris as the model for Hôtel Côte d'Azur. We include it because it provides an authentic example of the historic hospitality culture that inspired many Riviera writers.

### What makes it interesting?

The building's monumental architecture communicates the prestige of the district. Its position beside the casino reinforces the historic relationship between accommodation, entertainment and fashionable society. For the novel's young narrator, such a world is alluring but intimidating. The physical architecture helps make that emotional experience more understandable.

### Can you enter?

Hôtel de Paris is an operating luxury hotel, not a free public heritage museum. Access to rooms, lounges and other spaces depends on hotel and restaurant policies. After the grand façades, spend some time in the landscaped spaces around the casino district. The nearby gardens provide a useful contrast with the formality of the hotels and gaming rooms. They also introduce another aspect of the novel's Riviera setting: the opportunity to escape public social expectations, at least temporarily.

### Jardins de la Petite Afrique

These gardens near the casino district contain subtropical vegetation that reflects Monaco's mild coastal climate. Palm trees, large ornamental plants and carefully maintained landscaping create a calmer environment close to the busy square. The atmosphere is different from the hotel interiors, even though the gardens belong to the same historic resort landscape.

### What to think about while walking

In the novel, the narrator's experiences with Maxim create moments that feel separate from the social world controlled by Mrs Van Hopper. A peaceful public garden offers an appropriate place to reflect on that contrast. But the garden is a thematic stop. It isn't presented here as a confirmed location described by du Maurier.

Use open public garden paths and respect any temporary closures, maintenance works or event restrictions. The precise layout and planting have changed over time.

## 9. The Riviera road: travel as freedom and uncertainty

Cars and excursions matter in the Monte Carlo section of Rebecca. Leaving the hotel gives the narrator an opportunity to experience the region outside Mrs Van Hopper's immediate supervision. The movement away from public rooms into a landscape of roads and changing views becomes part of the relationship between the characters.

### Is there a documented driving route?

Not one that can responsibly be reconstructed as an exact modern tourist itinerary from the evidence used for this guide. The novel evokes Riviera travel without providing a reliable set of present-day filming-style location coordinates.

### How to experience the idea safely

Instead of trying to identify every bend in the road, consider a separate coastal excursion between Monaco and Menton. The regional railway offers views of the coastline and connections between the towns. You can also explore pedestrian promenades in either destination. A road trip is an option if you have a suitable vehicle, but it shouldn't become an attempt to recreate a fictional journey at speed or stop on unsafe roads for photographs.

The important connection is thematic: movement away from the hotel's rigid social environment.

Окрема поїздка між Монако й Ментоном прибережним поїздом або прогулянка публічними набережними допоможе зрозуміти контраст. На автомобілі не відтворюйте сцени на швидкості й не зупиняйтеся небезпечно заради фото. Зв'язок тематичний: вийти за межі жорсткого соціального порядку готелю.

As you walk, consider the same place from three perspectives. For Mrs Van Hopper, Monte Carlo is an opportunity to meet important people. ## 12. Novel, history and film: three different Rivieras

Rebecca has been adapted for the screen more than once. That creates an important distinction for our Books & Films series. The literary geography of the 1938 novel is not identical to the production geography of its adaptations.

### The novel: 1938

Monte Carlo is the setting for the narrator's first encounters with Maxim. The majority of the story later unfolds in England. The fictional Hôtel Côte d'Azur should not be treated as a verified real hotel.

### Hitchcock's film: 1940

Alfred Hitchcock directed the celebrated adaptation starring Joan Fontaine and Laurence Olivier. Its Riviera setting forms part of the fictional narrative, but the film was produced using studio facilities and other locations. It shouldn't be presented as evidence that particular scenes were filmed in Monaco.

### Netflix's Rebecca: 2020

Ben Wheatley's adaptation, starring Lily James and Armie Hammer, uses a combination of real Riviera sites and other buildings to evoke Monte Carlo. Published production accounts identify locations including the former Hôtel Régina in Nice, Villa Eilenroc in Antibes and the Exotic Garden of Monaco. The National Trust confirms that Waddesdon Manor in Buckinghamshire stood in for parts of the Monte Carlo hotel. These film locations are background information, not extra stops on this compact literary walk or evidence of present-day public access.

This provides an excellent example of screen geography. The story says Monte Carlo. The camera may actually be in Nice, Antibes or Buckinghamshire.

### Why it matters

A literary walking guide explores the world described in a book. A filming-location guide identifies the actual places used by a production. These are related but different kinds of research. The itinerary above follows the first approach. It is not intended as a frame-by-frame route through the 1940 or 2020 films.

Monte-Carlo accueille les premières rencontres, puis l'action principale se déplace en Angleterre. L'Hôtel Côte d'Azur fictif ne devient pas une adresse vérifiée parce qu'un film lui donne une façade.

Альфред Гічкок знімає Джоан Фонтейн і Лоуренса Олів'є. Сюжетна Рив'єра не доводить зйомок у Монако: AFI описує американське виробництво та роботу другої групи в Північній Каліфорнії. Кадр художньої історії не є географічним доказом.

## 13. Why Monte Carlo is only the beginning

The novel's Riviera chapters offer an attractive contrast with the darker world of Manderley. In Monte Carlo, the narrator is young, uncertain and fascinated by someone whose life appears far beyond her own experience. The hotel environment makes class and personal status highly visible. The Mediterranean landscape suggests freedom and possibility. Yet even here, there are signs that the story won't remain a conventional romance. The narrator's perception is shaped by insecurity. Maxim carries a past that she does not fully understand.

And the glamour surrounding them cannot resolve those difficulties. Once the story moves to England, the physical setting changes dramatically. The house, its rooms and its history become central. The sunny Riviera opening remains important because it establishes the emotional contrast. Without Monte Carlo, the reader would encounter the heroine's later circumstances differently.

## 13. Pourquoi Monte-Carlo n'est que le commencement

La Riviera ensoleillée contraste avec le monde de Manderley. La narratrice, jeune et incertaine, est fascinée par un homme dont l'existence paraît hors de portée. L'hôtel expose les différences de classe ; le paysage méditerranéen suggère une liberté possible.

Pourtant, l'insécurité de la jeune femme et le passé de Maxim empêchent déjà une romance simple. Le luxe ne résout pas leurs difficultés. En Angleterre, la maison, ses pièces et son histoire deviennent centrales ; le début au soleil prépare précisément ce changement émotionnel. Sans Monte-Carlo, nous lirions autrement la suite.

## 14. What kind of reader will enjoy Rebecca?

### Readers who enjoy psychological suspense

The novel is deeply interested in uncertainty, memory and the way people interpret incomplete information. The atmosphere matters as much as the plot.

### Readers of Gothic fiction

Manderley belongs to a long tradition of houses that seem to possess identities of their own. Its architectural presence is essential to the story.

### Readers interested in class and identity

The narrator's position as a paid companion in a wealthy hotel is an important part of the novel's opening. Her sense of inferiority shapes how she experiences the people around her.

### Readers who enjoy complicated romantic relationships

The relationship begins in an attractive Riviera setting, but du Maurier isn't offering a simple holiday romance. Power, grief and unequal experience shape the characters' interactions.

### Travellers interested in the Riviera's literary history

Even though Rebecca isn't mainly set in Monaco, its opening provides a rewarding perspective on Monte Carlo's historic luxury culture. It's particularly interesting alongside other Riviera fiction about British visitors, grand hotels and private estates.

## 14. À quels lecteurs plaira Rebecca ?

### Suspense psychologique

Le roman s'intéresse à la mémoire, aux interprétations et aux informations incomplètes. Son atmosphère compte autant que son intrigue.

### Fiction gothique

Manderley appartient à la tradition des maisons qui semblent posséder une identité. Son architecture n'est pas un simple arrière-plan.

### Classe et identité

L'emploi de dame de compagnie dans un hôtel riche façonne le sentiment d'infériorité et la perception des autres.

### Relations amoureuses complexes

Le début ressemble à un séjour romantique, mais pouvoir, deuil et expérience inégale compliquent la relation. Ce n'est pas une simple romance de vacances.

### Histoire littéraire de la Riviera

Même si Monaco n'occupe qu'une partie du livre, ses chapitres offrent une lecture intéressante des grands hôtels, des visiteurs britanniques et des domaines privés de la région.

## 14. A quali lettori piacerà Rebecca?

### Suspense psicologica

Memoria, incertezza e interpretazione di informazioni incomplete contano quanto la trama. L'atmosfera è decisiva.

### Narrativa gotica

Manderley appartiene alla tradizione delle case che sembrano avere un'identità propria. L'architettura non è semplice sfondo.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is Rebecca set in Monte Carlo?

Its early remembered chapters take place in Monte Carlo, where the unnamed narrator meets Maxim de Winter. Most of the novel's principal action later takes place at Manderley in England.

### Is the Hôtel Côte d'Azur a real hotel?

It's a fictional hotel in the novel. No specific present-day Monte Carlo establishment has been reliably identified as its real counterpart.

### Did Daphne du Maurier write Rebecca in Monaco?

No. Du Maurier began writing the novel in 1937 while living in Egypt and completed it after returning to England. Monte Carlo is a fictional setting, not an established writing location.

### Is Manderley in Monaco?

No. Manderley is the fictional English country estate at the heart of the novel, associated with Cornwall.

### Can you visit the real places behind the Monte Carlo chapters?

Yes. Place du Casino, historic hotel exteriors and public gardens provide a useful sense of the resort environment. They are contextual locations, not documented equivalents of every fictional scene.

### Is the Casino de Monte-Carlo in Rebecca?

The novel evokes Monte Carlo's fashionable hotel and resort society. The casino is included in this itinerary for historical context, not as a verified scene location.

### Can you visit from Menton without a car?

Yes. Regional trains connect Menton with Monaco-Monte-Carlo, and the casino district can be reached from the station on foot or by suitable local transport.

### Were the film adaptations shot in Monaco?

The answer depends on the adaptation. The 2020 film used locations in Monaco and elsewhere, including Nice, Antibes and England. The films' actual locations should not be confused with the novel's geography.

### Does this guide contain spoilers?

No major plot revelations or ending details are included. It discusses the novel's opening premise and central themes.

## Final thoughts: the Riviera before the shadows

In Rebecca, Monte Carlo represents a world of sunlight, elegance and apparent possibility. But Daphne du Maurier uses that beauty for more than atmosphere. The luxurious hotel is a place of social hierarchy. The narrator's position within it reveals her insecurity. And the meeting that changes her life begins amid circumstances she doesn't fully control. For visitors to Monaco today, the real Casino Square and surrounding hotels provide a fascinating connection with that vanished world of European luxury travel.

You can explore the architecture, walk through the gardens and imagine the expectations that governed the lives of wealthy visitors and those employed to accompany them. But remember that this is only the beginning of Rebecca. The Riviera introduces the romance. Manderley gives the novel its darker identity. And the distance between the two is one of the reasons du Maurier's story remains so powerful.

## Pour finir : la Riviera avant les ombres

Dans Rebecca, Monte-Carlo offre soleil, élégance et possibilité apparente. Mais le grand hôtel révèle aussi la hiérarchie, la fragilité de la narratrice et les conditions qu'elle ne maîtrise pas. Aujourd'hui, place et façades permettent de réfléchir à ce monde disparu, tandis que les jardins offrent une pause.

Il ne s'agit que du commencement : la Riviera introduit la romance, Manderley donne au roman son identité plus sombre. La distance entre ces deux mondes contribue à sa force durable.
